premises.text: Electrical lighting drives massive CO2 emissions, electricity use, and light pollution, while even LEDs depend on resource-intensive rare-metal extraction
premises.evidence_span: Electrical lighting is responsible for 1.7 billion tons of CO2 emissions, is 15% of global electricity consumption, and more than 80% of humans are affected by light pollution

premises.text: A living bioluminescent liquid material can grow light in any casing as a patented biological alternative with unique healthy-wavelength quality
premises.evidence_span: We created a growing and living raw material, bioluminescence material

premises.text: Bioluminescent genes from squids are engineered into lab-grown bacteria that are grown on industrial waste nutrients in shells or a Pipelight bioreactor for continuous closed-loop light
premises.evidence_span: we synthesize some genes coding for bioluminescent inside squids. Then we insert into lab-grown bacteria

premises.text: Glow Events ephemeral installations educate people and raise awareness as a path toward continuous Pipelight adoption
premises.evidence_span: events are great because they educate people. They raise consumer awareness

premises.text: Licensing the technology to energy providers who operate the system is the scale path in light installation and supply markets
premises.evidence_span: we are partnering with energy providers. So we license to them our technology, and they operate the system

premises.text: First commercial Pipelight targets hospitality and wellness venues such as hotels and spas
premises.evidence_span: putting a first pipelight product on the market in the beginning of 2019 for the hospitality industry, for the wellness industry, in hotels and spas

value.text: More livable and sustainable cities through biological lighting that cuts environmental impact
value.evidence_span: we want to design more livable and sustainable cities for tomorrow

secondary_value.text: Wellness from natural-light quality and healthful wavelength effects
secondary_value.evidence_span: improve wellness thanks to the quality of this natural light

secondary_value.text: New design possibilities for lighting form factors
secondary_value.evidence_span: offer a lot of new design possibilities to revolutionize the lighting industry
